cases.prompt: Convert this OpenAPI spec into a Postman collection.

files.openapi.yaml:
openapi: 3.0.3
servers:
  - url: https://api.example.com/v2
components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearer: { type: http, scheme: bearer }
security: [{ bearer: [] }]
paths:
  /pets/{id}:
    get:
      parameters:
        - { name: id, in: path, required: true, schema: { type: integer } }
      responses: { '200': { description: OK } }

expectations: Maps the server URL to a baseUrl variable.
Converts the path parameter to Postman syntax.
Sets bearer auth using a token variable.
